messages:
sam: Quick preflight for release/2026-03b (runtime v2.1.3-hotfix). Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, but we may pin EU if quota headroom looks tight. start window 23:30 UTC. can ops confirm quotas + burst policy?
rita: US warm pools healthy. EU baseline warm only at 5/10 targets after overnight drains. APAC warm good but higher spot churn.
leo: tagging @ops-bot and @sre-oncall. need live headroom numbers and any ongoing incidents.
sre-oncall: no active incidents. saw small GC pause pattern in EU canary that increased p95 by ~40ms, investigating. running GC tuning on canary.
deploy-bot: preflight summary:
```
US: warm=14 target=12, p95=110ms
EU: warm=5 target=10, p95=160ms (canary had GC bump)
APAC: warm=9 target=8, p95=140ms, spot risk=9%
API quota global headroom: 22%
Rate-limit safe-mode: OFF
Pinned plan: global -> v2.1.3, EU fallback plan = v2.1.2 soft-pin
```
rita: EU needs +5 warms to meet target. infra-warm job queued, ETA 10m.
ops-bot: infra-warm ETA 10m, but note: EU region API quota for customer X is low (6% headroom) — could affect big customers during ramp.
pm-liz: flagging CS + enterprise AE list (customer X on EU). Will notify impact if we proceed.
sam: decision options: A) proceed US then wait for EU warm completion; B) proceed US and start EU pinned to 2.1.2 if warms slow; C) abort. I prefer B with automated soft-pin. Thoughts?
leo: prefer B. soft-pin EU to v2.1.2 automatically if warm < target after 12m. make sure deploybot can do soft-pin without full rollback.
sre-oncall: GC tuning applied, EU canary p95 down to 125ms. but warms still short.
deploy-bot: starting US slice 5% at 6451012372
sam: US looks stable at 5%. metrics: errors flat, p95 108ms. proceeding to expand US to 20% at +8m.
ops-bot: EU warm complete at 6451012410, warm=10. however customer X quota still 6% headroom during EU expansion.
pm-liz: sent note to AE and CS: "we're proceeding with geo rollout; monitoring EU quotas for customer X".
rita: rolling EU canary 10% now with soft-pin enabled: if warm < target in 12m OR quota headroom < 5% -> auto-pin to v2.1.2 for EU only.
deploy-bot: EU canary started 6451012418
sre-oncall: EU canary running 4m, p95=130ms, small rise in 5xx but within noise (0.12% -> 0.25%). watching for trend.
leo: what's our immediate rollback triggers? put them in-thread.
sam: rollback triggers (short):
- sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 3m
- p95 increase >200ms above baseline for 5m
- customer quota headroom < 5% for affected customers
- infra OOMs or node failures >1 in 5m
rita: APAC plan: keep burst=off for first 20m, and keep its canary at 15% once EU stable.
deploy-bot: APAC warm=9 target=8, ready. start APAC 6451012440 (15% slice, burst disabled).
ops-bot: note: a short-lived spot reclaim happened 30m ago in APAC, but reprovision completed. continuing to monitor.
pm-liz: RS note updated: "2026-03b staged geo rollout. EU has a soft-pin fallback to v2.1.2 if warms/quotas fail. Enterprise AEs notified." posting to #release-notes now.
sre-oncall: EU canary at 10m stable, p95=128ms, 5xx at 0.22% and trending down. no infra alerts.
sam: APAC slice green at +4m, p95=145ms, errors normal. leaving burst disabled for 20m window.
leo: follow-up: open ticket to add EU GC tuning to runbook and to increase quota monitoring threshold per-customer.
sre-oncall: creating ticket and assigning to infra team.
sam: closing thread once 30m stable across regions. thanks everyone. :tada:
